encoding.u: v4.0 canonical full row SHA256 for unresolved keys

methods.binding: Require a unique own Census code or a unique exact-name official LGD village-to-Census crosswalk within the stored current district; agree state, own P31 settlement scope, row type/local type, name/own-item aliases, all active precise own-item points within 2 km and current district. Independently scan the full LGD village roster: require one LGD village per selected 2011 Census code and Rural/Inhabitant current status; Urban or Unmapped entries remain held pending historical extent review. LGD Census codes bridge post-2011 district changes; a current district name alone never supplies a 2011 code. Village rows take VILLAGE totals; census towns take TOWN (CT) totals. Hold statutory towns and municipalities without reviewed historical boundary continuity, conflicting scope/identifiers, unavailable sources and any potentially newer count. No UA, ward, district or subdistrict population can bind. Unresolved keys additionally require unchanged v4 name/state/point/own item, same entity evidence and a guarded reviewed decision_only event. Every row, including held and already-agreeing rows, appears once.
methods.population: PCA Data sheet TOT_P; verified TOT_P=TOT_M+TOT_F; year 2011; only TOWN and VILLAGE level, zero ward and enumeration-block codes
methods.limits: Conservative build: held rows retain all scalar values. No absence or zero population is inferred from failed matching. Census/own-item agreement is evidence, not geometric proof of unchanged municipal boundaries.
methods.owner_rule: Only add 2011 to a stored count equal to its proved own 2011 count (Y), or replace a count attributed with evidence to another entity (W). All differing stored counts without that attribution remain unchanged. Numerical proximity alone is not attribution. Missing counts are outside Y/W.
methods.history: v4.0 contributions/cities/IN.json; latest identity decisions replayed in first-parent order from immutable unresolved baseline then ordinary identity events.

credit: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract. Corresponding village/town PCA data are published under the Government Open Data Licence - India (data.gov.in): https://www.data.gov.in/sites/default/files/Gazette_Notification_OGDL.pdf ; https://www.data.gov.in/catalog/villagetown-wise-primary-census-abstract-2011-nct-delhi . National PCA workbooks: https://censusindia.gov.in/census.website/en/data/population-finder . Modifications: selected and matched 2011 own-town and own-village population totals to existing Indian records; excluded urban agglomeration, district, subdistrict and ward totals. No endorsement by the data provider is implied. Identity checks also use LGD (https://lgdirectory.gov.in/downloadDirectory.do) and Wikidata (CC0 1.0); those are not population sources.
